description: Create or overwrite a GDScript (.gd) file. The code is compiled first; on errors nothing is written and the errors (with line numbers) are returned. Returns a unified diff for changed files and a one-line summary for new ones. Undoable with edit_undo. For small changes to an existing file prefer script_edit.

dry_run.description: Preview only: validate and describe the change without applying it.

name: script_write
title: Write script
